children: enGene Therapeutics Inc. reported a net loss of $32.5M for the third quarter of fiscal 2026, compared with a net loss of $29M in the year-ago quarter; diluted loss per share was $0.47 versus $0.57 in 3Q FY2025. The company did not report product revenue for the period.
Revenue: No product sales reported for the period.
Net income: Net loss of $32.5M for 3Q FY2026, compared with a net loss of $29.0M in 3Q FY2025.
Diluted EPS: Net loss per share, basic and diluted, of $0.47 for 3Q FY2026, versus $0.57 in the year-ago quarter.
Clinical progress: Updated Phase 2 LEGEND pivotal cohort showed any-time complete response (CR) of 54% with Kaplan‑Meier estimates at 6/9/12 months of 39.4% / 31.6% / 24.5%.
Pipeline expansion: LEGEND study expanded to add a surfactant (polidocanol) bladder rinse cohort intended to potentially boost intravesical delivery efficacy.
Operational restructuring: Approximately 50% workforce reduction in June 2026 to preserve cash while retaining resources to complete the pivotal cohort and BLA planning.
Regulatory pathway: Company expects FDA engagement and plans to initiate a BLA submission in Q4 2026, targeting a potential commercial launch in 2027 if approved.
Cash runway & focus: Management believes existing cash and securities will fund operations for at least 12 months, prioritizing completion of the LEGEND pivotal cohort and pre-commercial activities.
